description: List the bank accounts the org can off-ramp to, with the currency each receives and the chain and token the off-ramp sends. Pass an id to `transactions create offramp`. Requires an owner-scoped API key for an org owner.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: offramp_external-accounts
